description: Netbeheergebieden elektriciteit, gas, media, riolering, warmte en water is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodata.mijnaansluiting.nl. Stichting Mijn Aansluiting provides the storage and technical management of area information that is used by Mijnsluiting.nl and is offered as publicly available open data via OGC WMS/WFS services. Network management areas are the areas where network operators operate. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Grid management areas electricity, gas, media, sewerage, heat and water" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include warmte, media, netbeheergebied, netbeheergebieden, gas, energie. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2025-11-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
